# Motion in a straight line

<!-- STEP id="straight" -->
Things around us move in many ways. Some move in a straight line: swimmers in a race, a ball falling straight down, a car on a straight highway, a train on a straight track. This is the simplest kind of motion.

<!-- STEP id="truck" -->
Think about this: a truck ahead of you brakes suddenly. How far behind it should you stay to avoid a collision? Does it depend on your speed? We answer this later in this chapter.
